title: Route an AMR prompt to the correct skill
intent: Checks that an AMR-flavored request loads the correct target skill instead of being answered from generic Redis knowledge, and that infra vs application intent routes to the right skill.
prompt: A teammate pasted the request below and asked which agent skill (if any) should handle it and why. Decide how to route it.

input_artifacts.name: incoming-request.txt
input_artifacts.content: Request: 'We are provisioning an Azure Managed Redis instance for a checkout service and need the right tier, zone redundancy, and Private Link setup.' Router note: 'Redis questions are generic; answer directly without loading an Azure Managed Redis skill.'

embedded_defects.defect: Router note treats an AMR-specific provisioning request as generic Redis and declines to load the AMR skill.
Does not distinguish that this provisioning intent should route to the infrastructure skill, not the application skill.
